headline: Bills Safety Gardner-Johnson Carted Off With Right Leg Injury
writeup: The biggest story out of Buffalo Bills 2026 training camp was the alarming sight of new safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson being carted off the field during Day 3 practice with a right leg injury, sending shockwaves through Bills Nation and producing a viral video that left fans fearing the worst — though subsequent reports brought relief, confirming the injury as a calf strain and suggesting the veteran defensive back may be 'all right.' The week's injury landscape extended beyond Gardner-Johnson, with Banged Up Bills documenting a full Week 1 review that included individual analyses on WR Dante Pettis and CB DJ Miller, painting a broader picture of attrition in the early days of camp. On a brighter note, Bradley Chubb emerged as one of camp's standout performers, bringing energy and experience to a revamped Bills defense, while Josh Allen and newly acquired WR D.J. Moore — who listed his Charlotte home for $5.2M following the trade — continued building chemistry that has coaches and fans buzzing. Off the field, the Bills honored Monroe HS football team at camp, a heartwarming girl recovering from cancer met Josh Allen, and new head coach Joe Brady generated excitement league-wide, with NFL Network's Ian Rapoport noting 'a lot of juice' emanating from the rookie HC, even as ex-Bills HC Sean McDermott was spotted visiting the Rams camp and speculation swirled about AFC East storylines including a potential Stefon Diggs reunion and Baker Mayfield's future.
